item.title: Kookmin University HUSS Global Coexistence Project Team Hosts '2026 Global Coexistence Joint Academic Festival' (국민대 HUSS 글로벌공생사업단, ‘2026 글로벌공생 연합학술제’ 개최)
item.description:
On May 29, the HUSS Global Coexistence Project Team at Kookmin University (President Jeong Seung-ryeol) held the finals for the 3rd '2026 Global Coexistence Joint Academic Festival' in Room 301 of the Management Building on campus. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬) HUSS 글로벌공생사업단은 지난 5월 29일 교내 경영관 301호에서 제3회 ‘2026 글로벌공생 연합학술제’ 본선을 개최했다.)

This event was a joint academic festival involving the five participating universities (Kwangwoon University, Kookmin University, Sun Moon University, Yeungnam University, and Honam University) of the HUSS Global Coexistence Consortium, supported by the Ministry of Education and the National Research Foundation of Korea, and was organized by Kookmin University's Global Coexistence Project Team. This year's academic festival, under the theme 'Proposing Multidisciplinary Problem-Solving Ideas for Global Sustainable Coexistence and Growth,' was conducted from March 30 to May 29, divided into preliminary rounds and finals. (이번 행사는 교육부와 한국연구재단이 지원하는 HUSS 글로벌공생컨소시엄의 5개 참여대학(광운대, 국민대, 선문대, 영남대, 호남대)이 함께한 연합 학술 행사로, 국민대 글로벌공생사업단이 주관했다. 올해 학술제는 ‘글로벌 지속가능 공생 및 성장을 위한 다학제적 문제 해결 아이디어 제안’을 주제로 3월 30일부터 5월 29일까지 예선과 본선으로 나뉘어 진행됐다.)

The academic festival was designed to analyze complex issues facing global society—such as the climate crisis, social inequality, demographic changes, cultural conflicts, and ethical issues arising from technological advancement—from the perspective of university students, and to seek solutions through interdisciplinary collaboration based on diverse academic knowledge. (학술제는 기후위기, 사회적 불평등, 인구 구조 변화, 문화 갈등, 기술 발전에 따른 윤리 문제 등 글로벌 사회가 직면한 복합적 문제를 대학생의 시각에서 분석하고, 다양한 전공 지식을 바탕으로 전공 간 협업을 통해 해결 방안을 모색하기 위해 마련됐다.)

Nine teams that advanced to the finals presented ideas across various fields, including sustainability, technology, welfare, culture, language, and urban issues. Each team explained their problem awareness, solutions, and expected outcomes through presentations and Q&A sessions. The judges comprehensively evaluated topic suitability, creativity, multidisciplinary approach, feasibility, and presentation skills. The finals were judged by Professor Ahn Hyun-chul (School of Management Information Systems), Professor Thompson Ephraim Kwasi (KIBS), and Professor Joo Song-ha (Department of Political Science and International Relations). (본선에 오른 9개 팀은 지속가능성, 기술, 복지, 문화, 언어, 도시 문제 등 다양한 분야의 아이디어를 발표했다. 각 팀은 발표와 질의응답을 통해 문제의식, 해결 방안, 기대 효과를 설명했으며, 심사위원들은 주제 적합성, 창의성, 다학제적 접근, 실행 가능성, 발표 역량 등을 종합적으로 평가했다. 본선 심사는 안현철 교수(경영정보학부), 톰슨 에브라임 과시 교수(KIBS), 주송하 교수(정치외교학과)가 맡았다.)

The Grand Prize was awarded to the 'MediBridge' team from Yeungnam University, which proposed a 'Cultural Idiom-Based Symptom Translation and Hospital Matching Solution' to improve medical accessibility for international students. The Best Excellence Award went to the 'Sipsiilbap' team from Kookmin University, which presented the 'Make One Extra Portion' campaign for underprivileged youth. Excellence Awards were given to the 'CitySeed' joint team from Kwangwoon University and Sun Moon University for proposing an AI-based citizen-participatory carbon behavior transition platform using living-area energy data, the 'Gwiyeopjo' team from Kookmin University for presenting an AI-based user-customized, accessibility-focused cultural tourism integrated platform, and the 'Solocare' team from Kookmin University for proposing an AI-based monitoring system to prevent solitary deaths among single-person households. Other finalist teams were awarded the 'Global Coexistence Award.' (대상은 외국인 유학생의 의료 접근성 향상을 위한 ‘문화적 관용어 기반 증상 번역 및 병원 매칭 솔루션’을 제안한 영남대 ‘메디브릿지’ 팀이 수상했다. 최우수상은 취약계층 청소년을 위한 ‘1인분 더 만들기’ 캠페인을 발표한 국민대 ‘십시일밥’ 팀이 받았다. 우수상은 생활권 에너지 데이터를 활용한 AI 기반 시민 참여형 탄소행동 전환 플랫폼을 제안한 광운대·선문대 연합팀 ‘시티시드’, AI 기반 사용자 맞춤형 접근성 중심 문화관광 통합 플랫폼을 발표한 국민대 ‘귀엽조’ 팀, AI를 활용한 1인 가구 고독사 예방 모니터링 시스템을 제안한 국민대 ‘Solocare’ 팀이 각각 수상했다. 그 밖의 본선 진출팀에도 ‘글로벌공생상’이 수여됐다.)

Professor Ahn Hyun-chul from Kookmin University's Global Coexistence Project Team, who organized the event, stated, "This academic festival was a platform where students interpreted complex issues of global society based on their majors and areas of interest, and proposed solutions through multidisciplinary collaboration." He added, "We will continue to expand various programs so that students can experience the values of a sustainable future and global coexistence as they grow." (행사를 주관한 국민대 글로벌공생사업단 안현철 교수는 “이번 학술제는 학생들이 글로벌 사회의 복합적 문제를 자신의 전공과 관심 분야에 기반해 해석하고, 다학제적 협업을 통해 해결 방안을 제안해 본 자리였다”며 “앞으로도 학생들이 지속가능한 미래와 글로벌 공생의 가치를 체감하며 성장할 수 있도록 다양한 프로그램을 확대해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, the HUSS Global Coexistence Consortium, supported by the Ministry of Education and the National Research Foundation of Korea for three years starting in 2024, is jointly operated by Kwangwoon University, Kookmin University, Sun Moon University, Yeungnam University, and Honam University. The consortium aims to nurture 2,500 convergent talents equipped with sustainable resource responsiveness, sustainable industry understanding, and sustainable international community inclusivity, promoting various educational and international exchange programs. (한편 HUSS 글로벌공생컨소시엄은 2024년부터 3년간 교육부와 한국연구재단의 지원을 받아 광운대, 국민대, 선문대, 영남대, 호남대가 공동 운영하고 있다. 컨소시엄은 지속가능 자원 대응력, 지속가능 산업 이해력, 지속가능 국제사회 포용력을 갖춘 융합인재 2,500명 양성을 목표로 다양한 교육 및 국제교류 프로그램을 추진하고 있다.)

item.title: Private School Pension to Conduct '2026 Retirement Preparation Training' for Scheduled Retirees (사학연금, 퇴직 예정 교직원 대상 ‘2026년 퇴임대비 연수’ 실시)
item.description:
The Private School Teachers and Staff Pension Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the Private School Pension, Chairman Song Ha-jung) announced on the 8th that it will conduct the '2026 First Retirement Preparation Training' for 150 scheduled regular (honorary) retiring faculty and staff from June 8 to 10 at Maison Glad Jeju. (사립학교교직원연금공단(이하 사학연금, 이사장 송하중)은 6월 8일부터 10일까지 정년(명예)퇴직 예정 교직원 150명을 대상으로 메종글래드 제주에서 ‘2026년 제1차 퇴임대비 연수’를 실시한다고 8일 밝혔다.)

This training includes education on the Private School Pension system and welfare programs that faculty and staff must know before retirement, along with guidance on the Teachers' Mutual Aid Association and National Health Insurance system, special lectures on asset management and tax-saving strategies, and lectures on slow-aging health methods. It also includes social gatherings where participants can share know-how on preparing for retirement and post-retirement life. (이번 연수는 교직원들이 퇴직 전 꼭 알아야 할 사학연금제도, 복지사업 프로그램에 대한 교육과 더불어 교직원공제회 및 국민건강보험 제도 안내, 자산관리‧절세 특강, 저속노화 건강법 강의로 이루어지며, 노후 준비와 퇴직 후 생활에 대한 노하우 등을 함께 공유할 수 있는 친교의 시간도 마련되어 있다.)

Chairman Song Ha-jung stated, "I hope this training provides a valuable time for faculty and staff facing the third act of life to systematically prepare for a comfortable and happy retirement." (송하중 이사장은 “이번 연수를 통해 인생 3막을 앞둔 교직원이 편안하고 행복한 노후생활을 체계적으로 준비할 수 있도록 유익한 정보를 얻을 수 있는 시간이 되기를 바란다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the Private School Pension's 2026 Retirement Preparation Training will be conducted a total of four times—twice in Jeju Island and twice in Seoul—targeting approximately 660 people. For faculty and staff unable to attend in person, regional retirement preparation briefings and online education through the integrated welfare platform (welfare.tp.or.kr) will also be provided. (한편, 사학연금 2026년 퇴임대비 연수는 약 660명을 대상으로 제주도와 서울에서 각 2회씩 총 4회 실시되며, 연수 참석이 어려운 교직원을 위해 지역별 퇴임대비 설명회와 공단 통합복지플랫폼(welfare.tp.or.kr)을 통한 온라인 교육도 제공될 예정이다.)

item.title: “Institutional Investors Must Also Consider ESG Factors When Engaging with Companies”… Amended Stewardship Code (“기관투자자가 기업에 관여할 때 ESG 요소도 고려”…스튜어드십 코드 개정안)
item.description:
<<>> A public hearing has been held on amendments aimed at transforming the stewardship code (principles for institutional investors’ fiduciary duties), which has been operated in a perfunctory manner, into a substantive responsible investment norm befitting the era of the KOSPI index at 8,000. <<> The Korea ESG Standards Institute (hereinafter KESGI) and the Korea Exchange held a related public hearing on the 8th at the Korea Exchange Conference Hall in Yeouido, Seoul. KESGI will collect public opinions until the 26th of this month, and then finalize the amendment by synthesizing the expert opinions presented on this day. <<> The stewardship code is a principle that institutional investors, like faithful stewards managing client funds, should responsibly exercise voting rights and actively engage to enhance the value of invested companies and shareholder interests. Unlike legalized norms such as the Commercial Act and the Capital Markets Act, it is considered a soft law because institutional investors can autonomously decide whether to join the code and implement it flexibly. <<> Since its enactment at the end of 2016, the domestic stewardship code has not been amended once, and it has been criticized for being nominal due to the inadequate system for implementing and monitoring institutional investors’ engagement activities. However, as institutional investor engagement in the capital market is effective in improving the backward corporate governance structure, a major cause of the Korea Discount, the need to substantiate the implementation of the stewardship code has been consistently raised. President Lee Jae-myung promised to strengthen the stewardship code in his election pledges and national tasks. <<> The core of the amendment unveiled by KESGI on this day is not merely to broaden institutional investors' shareholder engagement but to redesign it around substance, accountability, and follow-up monitoring. Key contents include: △Allowing the scope of assets to which the stewardship code applies to be voluntarily expanded from existing domestic listed stocks to bonds, real estate, infrastructure, unlisted stocks, and overseas assets; △Explicitly listing environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors and sustainability as non-financial elements, linking them not just to ethical slogans but to the long-term value of investee companies for shareholder engagement activities; △Establishing a new provision enabling "collaborative engagement activities" where institutional investors join forces; △Broadening the scope of shareholder engagement beyond dialogue with companies and exercising voting rights to encompass overall investment decisions such as investment expansion or withdrawal; △Reflecting the amended Commercial Act's duty of loyalty to shareholders, requiring checks on whether the board of directors of investee companies diligently performs its duties for the company and shareholders; △Mandating institutional investors to prepare guidelines for fiduciary responsibility activities, enhancing accountability through engagement stages, escalation procedures, periodic reporting, and report submissions; △Requiring institutional investors to submit annual activity reports to KESGI for monitoring stewardship code implementation; △Strengthening the role of the Stewardship Code Development Committee to review the need for code amendments every three years and annually monitor the level of fiduciary responsibility implementation of participating institutions. <<> Experts who participated in the discussion on this day generally acknowledged that this amendment aligns with the direction of developing the stewardship code into an effective responsible investment norm, while pointing out omissions in the amendment process or potential issues that may arise during implementation. <<> Furthermore, the civic group Economic Reform Alliance (Director: Kim Woo-chan, Professor at Korea University) issued a commentary on the 9th, evaluating the amendment as "very insufficient as it lacks practical means to induce institutional investors to implement the stewardship code." Specifically, the amendment entrusts the monitoring of stewardship code implementation to the Stewardship Code Development Committee (hereinafter Development Committee), but a part-time private committee commissioned by KESGI is limited in checking the code implementation of 257 institutional investors. Even if KESGI, as the secretariat, supports the work, they have only two to three staff members handling related tasks, making it difficult to say they have sufficient support capabilities. Moreover, since KESGI conducts business with institutions, there are concerns about conflicts of interest even if a firewall is established. The Economic Reform Alliance suggested that the Financial Supervisory Service, which has adequate human and professional capabilities, would be a more realistic option. The alliance also pointed out that the amendment does not include provisions for disclosing monitoring results and does not explicitly grant the Development Committee the authority to exclude non-compliant institutions from code participation. <<> At the public hearing, concerns were raised about the uncertainty of the scope and potential for abuse of sustainability factors like ESG newly introduced. Professor Kim Jian of Pusan National University (Law School) pointed out, "It should be clearly stated that sustainability factors like ESG are not independent objectives but elements considered to the extent they affect the long-term interests of clients and fiduciaries and the long-term value of investment assets." He also proposed, as the UK did in its recent stewardship code revision, introducing the concept of 'systemic risk' affecting the market and financial system more broadly than ESG, allowing coverage of geopolitics, supply chains, artificial intelligence (AI), and cybersecurity. <<> Lee Chang-hwan, CEO of Align Partners, warned that expanding ESG could lead to 'ESG washing,' diluting governance issues. "The essence of the Korea Discount is not a lack of climate action or social contribution but a governance structure centered on controlling shareholders and a lack of shareholder returns," he said. "Treating ESG equally in guidelines risks giving a free pass to ESG washing, where controlling shareholders cause immense damage to ordinary shareholders through unfair mergers, only to argue that they have increased eco-friendly investments." <<> Opinions were also raised on the need to substantiate the reports that serve as the basis for monitoring implementation. The suggestion was to transform the implementation reports, which have been at the level of checklists for regulatory compliance, into reports centered on practice and explanation. Professor Lee Ji-yoon of Yonsei University (Business Administration) evaluated this amendment as strengthening transparency and accountability in institutional investors' judgment criteria and decision-making processes, stating, "This direction aligns with the fundamental purpose of the stewardship code and can ultimately lead to behavioral changes among institutional investors." <<> Lee Dong-seop, Head of Fiduciary Responsibility at the National Pension Service (NPS), stated that institutional investors' implementation reports "should focus on outcomes, describing how shareholder engagement activities have practically influenced corporate value enhancement and governance improvement." He also noted that because NPS entrusts half of its managed assets to external managers, the capacity of these entrusted managers is directly linked to NPS's overall stewardship code implementation capability. "NPS aims to check the stewardship code implementation level of entrusted asset managers and reflect the results more substantially in the evaluation and selection of entrusted managers," he said. <<> It was pointed out that a certain follow-up evaluation system is essential for reporting and monitoring to have practical significance. Professor Lee Ji-yoon noted, "In the UK, the content of published reports is evaluated, and institutions that fall short of standards lose their signatory (participant) status." She added, "In Korea, we could consider measures that, after a long period, review the participating institution's qualifications if it fails to faithfully fulfill its obligations or submits only formal reports with insufficient actual activity." <<> The need for supplementation to ensure genuine engagement activities align with the clarified duty of loyalty to shareholders following last year's Commercial Act amendment was also pointed out. CEO Lee Chang-hwan emphasized the importance of focusing monitoring on conflicts of interest between controlling and ordinary shareholders to clarify the abstract duty of loyalty. "It would be good to clearly establish as a core criterion for monitoring and engagement whether the board of directors has sufficiently considered the interests of all shareholders in situations of conflict, such as disposal of treasury shares, third-party allotment capital increases, mergers, tender offers, delistings, and dual listings," he said. The need for communication channels between institutional investors and boards of directors was also highlighted. Lawyer Sook-mi Lee (Shin & Kim) stated, "Most engagement activities have been practitioner-centered," and "We need to shift toward board-centered communication engagement, which could involve utilizing the compensation committee or ESG committee within the board." <<> The collaborative engagement activities reflected in this amendment were evaluated as significant. CEO Lee Chang-hwan said, "It is difficult for a single shareholder to engage effectively; multiple institutions raising a collective voice is key to the effectiveness of engagement, and the stewardship codes of major countries, including the UK, actively encourage this," expressing hope for conditions that enable such engagement activities to operate well. <<> A proposal was also made to link the stewardship code with the Value-Up Program to enhance effectiveness. This involves the Korea Exchange reflecting the evaluation of corporate value enhancement plans when selecting 10 companies annually. Cho Jin-woo, Head of the Corporate Value-Up Support Division at the Korea Exchange, stated, "Companies that actively respond to institutional investors' proactive engagement are more likely to have a genuine will for corporate value enhancement activities, so this could be included as a qualitative evaluation factor in selecting excellent Value-Up companies." <<> Text and photos by Lee Bong-hyun, Research Fellow at the Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute ESG Center bhlee@hani.co.kr ()

item.title: A Nausea-Inducing Stock Market... Underneath It All, 'Semiconductor and Large-Cap Concentration' (멀미 나는 주식시장…이면엔 ‘반도체·대형주 쏠림’)
item.description:
The KOSPI is in the midst of extreme volatility, plunging 8% the day before and then surging 8% the next day on the 9th, recovering all losses. Amid a number of sidecar measures—one of the stock market stabilization tools—approaching the total number triggered during the entire 2008 global financial crisis, there are assessments that the volatility stems from a weakened market foundation due to a concentration on semiconductor stocks. (코스피가 전날 8% 폭락했다가 다음 날인 9일 8% 급등하며 하락분을 모두 회복하는 극심한 변동성 장세 한복판에 있다. 주식시장 안정화 조처 중 하나인 사이드카 횟수가 2008년 글로벌 금융위기 한 해 동안 벌어진 횟수에 다다른 가운데, 변동성 이면에는 반도체 쏠림 현상으로 증시 기반이 약해진 탓이란 평가가 나온다.)

On this day, the KOSPI closed at 8096.93, surging 8.18% from the previous trading day, fully recovering the 8000-point level it had lost after an 8.29% crash the day before. The KOSPI 200 Volatility Index (VKOSPI), known as the Korean Fear Index, recorded 91.23, far exceeding the level (80.37) seen on March 4th, right after the outbreak of the US-Israel-Iran war. This is even higher than the peak (89.30) during the 2008 global financial crisis. Although a circuit breaker, which halts trading for 20 minutes, was triggered by the previous day's index crash, on this day, a surge in the KOSPI 200 futures price—a leading indicator—triggered a buy sidecar (suspending program buying for 5 minutes). The number of sidecars triggered when the market fluctuates sharply totaled 23 times just in the first half of this year (January to June 9th), approaching the all-time record of 26 times in 2008 during the global financial crisis, indicating severe volatility. (이날 코스피는 전 거래일 대비 8.18% 급등한 8096.93에 거래를 마쳤다. 전날 8.29% 폭락하며 내줬던 8000선을 그대로 회복한 모습이다. 한국형 공포지수라고 불리는 코스피200 변동성 지수(VKOSPI)는 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 발발 직후인 지난 3월4일 수준(80.37)을 훨씬 뛰어넘은 91.23을 기록했다. 이는 글로벌 금융위기가 한창이던 2008년 최고수치(89.30)보다도 높다. 전날 지수 폭락으로 20분간 매매거래를 정지하는 서킷브레이커가 발동했지만, 이날은 선행지표인 코스피200선물 가격이 급등해 매수 사이드카(5분간 프로그램매수 효력정지)가 발동했다. 증시가 급격히 출렁일 때 발동하는 사이드카 횟수는 올해 상반기(1월∼6월9일)만 총 23차례인데, 역대 최다 횟수를 기록했던 글로벌 금융위기 당시 2008년(26차례)에 벌써 근접할 정도로 변동성이 심각하다.)

Analysis suggests that the reason for the KOSPI's repeated surges and crashes is the extreme concentration of the domestic stock market on large-cap stocks, centered on semiconductors. The main cause of the KOSPI's sharp rise on this day was the rebound of AI semiconductor-related stocks, such as US-based Broadcom and major semiconductor stock Micron Technology, which rose 2.82% and 9.87% respectively in the New York stock market the previous day, reigniting doubts about the semiconductor investment frenzy due to earnings controversies. With Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix accounting for half of the KOSPI's market capitalization, the entire domestic stock market is ultimately being heavily shaken by global semiconductor profit outlooks. (코스피가 폭등과 폭락을 거듭하는 이유로는 국내 증시가 반도체를 중심으로 대형주에 극단적으로 쏠려 있기 때문이라는 분석이 나온다. 이날 코스피 급등의 주요 원인은 실적 논란으로 반도체 투자 열풍 의구심에 불을 붙였던 미국의 브로드컴과 반도체 대형주 마이크론 테크놀로지가 전날 뉴욕 증시에서 각각 2.82%, 9.87% 상승하는 등 인공지능 반도체 관련주가 반등한 영향이다. 삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스가 코스피 시가총액의 절반을 차지하는 상황에서 결국 세계 반도체 이익전망에 따라 국내 증시 전체가 크게 흔들리고 있는 것이다.)

Looking at the returns of the securities market last month, which experienced high volatility, the large-cap index (comprising the top 1-100 stocks by market cap) rose 33.01%, while small-cap stocks actually fell by 14.47%. In terms of market capitalization, the market cap of KOSPI large-cap stocks increased by 1,545 trillion won last month, but the market cap of small-cap stocks decreased by 16 trillion won. This means that as the KOSPI surged nearly 2,000 points in one month and total market cap increased by 1,525 trillion won, investment funds were entirely concentrated in KOSPI large-cap stocks. For the KOSDAQ, where small and medium-sized enterprises and venture companies are listed, the gap is even more severe. Last month, the KOSDAQ return fell by 9.86% over the month, and its market cap decreased by 61 trillion won. (변동성이 심했던 지난달 유가증권시장 수익률을 살펴보면, 시가총액 상위 1∼100위에 해당하는 대형주 지수는 33.01% 상승했지만, 소형주는 오히려 14.47% 하락했다. 시가총액으로 봐도 코스피 대형주 시가총액은 지난달 1545조원이 늘었지만, 소형주 시가총액은 16조원 빠졌다. 코스피가 한 달 새 2천포인트 가까이 뛰며 전체 시가총액도 1525조원 늘어나는 동안 투자자금은 온통 코스피 대형주로 몰렸단 뜻이다. 중소·벤처기업이 모여있는 코스닥의 경우엔 그 격차가 더욱 심하다. 지난달 코스닥 수익률을 보면 한 달 동안 9.86%가 떨어졌고, 시가총액은 61조원 감소했다.)

On this day, the KOSPI had 774 rising stocks and 133 falling stocks, showing a relative easing of the concentration phenomenon. The ADR (Advance-Decline Ratio) index, which represents the ratio of rising to falling stocks over 20 trading days, had been declining to its lowest level (imbalance) in the last five years but showed a slight increase to 50.32%. However, in the securities industry, the prevailing opinion is that the volatility caused by the concentration phenomenon should be accepted as a constant of the domestic stock market and responded to accordingly. Lee Kyung-min, a researcher at Daishin Securities, pointed out, "While inflows of bargain-hunting funds led to broad-based strength across sectors, the differentiation between sectors was clear during the process of digesting supply from short-term sharp fluctuations." (이날 코스피 상승 종목은 774개, 하락 종목은 133개로 쏠림 현상이 비교적 완화되는 모습을 보였다. 20거래일 동안 상승한 종목과 하락한 종목의 비율을 나타내는 에이디알(ADR) 지수는 최근 5년 이래 최저 수준(불균형)으로 하락하고 있었으나 소폭 상승한 50.32%를 나타냈다. 다만 증권가에서는 쏠림 현상에 의한 변동성을 국내 증시의 상수로 받아들이고 대응해야 한다는 의견이 주를 이룬다. 이경민 대신증권 연구원은 “저가 매수세 유입으로 업종 전반이 강세를 보였으나, 단기 급등락에 따른 매물 소화 과정에서 업종별 차별화는 뚜렷했다”고 지적했다.)

Reporter Kim Ga-yoon gayoon@hani.co.kr (김가윤 기자 gayoon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Preparing the Physical AI Ecosystem with Record Tax Surplus… Solution to Polarization 'Nowhere in Sight' (역대급 초과세수로 피지컬AI 생태계 조성 채비…양극화 해법은 ‘감감’)
item.description:
After President Lee Jae-myung indicated in his first-year anniversary press conference the previous day that the tax revenue increase from the semiconductor supercycle would be used as a foundation for future growth, the government's plan to utilize the increased tax revenue appears to be taking shape quickly. The government is rushing discussions on creating a national wealth fund for future generations and establishing a separate fund, aiming for strategic investment to complete the physical artificial intelligence (AI) ecosystem. (전날 이재명 대통령이 취임 1년 기자회견을 통해 반도체 슈퍼사이클(초호황)로 인한 세수 증가분을 미래 성장을 위한 발판으로 활용하겠다는 뜻을 밝힌 뒤, 정부의 세수 증가분 활용 방안이 빠르게 구체화되는 모양새다. 정부는 피지컬 인공지능(AI) 생태계 완성을 위한 전략적 투자를 목표 삼아, 미래 세대를 위한 국부펀드 조성과 별도 기금 조성 논의를 서두르고 있다.)

Focused Investment in Robot Eyes and Joints (로봇의 눈과 관절 집중 투자)

The government plans to expand semiconductor investment targets to sensors, following memory, to elevate all core areas of physical AI to world-class levels. A senior government official said on the 9th, "Sensor semiconductors go into all sensory organs of physical AI, such as LiDAR (technology serving as eyes for autonomous vehicles) and the visual and tactile senses of robots," adding, "If we achieve results in sensors following memory, we can sufficiently become one of the 'Top 3 in AI.'" This means fostering second and third memory semiconductors amid the era's shift to physical AI, leveraging Korea's rare manufacturing ecosystem that combines robotics, AI, semiconductor ecosystems, and an excellent manufacturing environment. (정부는 메모리에 이어 반도체 투자 대상을 센서 등으로 넓혀 피지컬 인공지능의 핵심 분야를 모두 세계 최고 수준으로 끌어올린다는 방침이다. 정부 고위 관계자는 9일 “자율주행차의 라이다(눈 역할을 하는 기술), 로봇의 시각·촉각 등 피지컬 에이아이의 모든 감각기관에 센서 반도체가 들어간다”며 “메모리에 이어 센서 등에서 성과를 내면 충분히 ‘인공지능 3강’에 들 수 있다”고 말했다. 로봇과 인공지능, 반도체 생태계와 우수한 제조업 환경을 갖춘 보기 드문 한국의 제조업 생태계를 기반으로 피지컬 인공지능으로의 시대적 전환에 제2·제3의 메모리 반도체를 육성하겠다는 의미다.)

Earlier, the government had allocated budget for research and development (R&D) support for power semiconductors, a key component of data center cooling technology, last year. It plans to actively develop similar projects and focus investment on the three core component industries: sensor semiconductors, actuators (joints), and power semiconductors, which are essential parts of physical AI. (앞서 정부는 지난해 데이터센터 냉각 기술의 핵심인 전력 반도체 연구개발(R&D) 지원 등에 예산을 투입한 바 있다. 유사한 사업을 적극 개발해 피지컬 인공지능의 핵심 부품인 센서 반도체를 비롯해 액추에이터(관절), 전력 반도체 등 3대 핵심 부품 산업에 집중 투자한다는 방침이다.)

These investment projects will utilize not only fiscal programs like R&D support but also mid- to long-term investments through separate funding sources, such as the national wealth fund and a future growth fund (tentative name). To this end, the Ministry of Planning and Budget is reviewing the establishment of a dedicated fund using the tax surplus. The plan is to store the increased tax revenue in a 'money purse' that can be used for the specific purpose of 'investment in future generations.' A government official stated, "When tax revenue is not favorable, it's difficult to significantly increase discretionary spending from a future growth investment perspective due to fixed mandatory expenditures," adding, "Having a fund with compartments can resolve this issue." (이런 투자사업에는 연구개발 지원 등 재정사업뿐만 아니라, 국부펀드·미래성장기금(가칭) 등 별도 재원 조성을 통한 중장기 투자가 활용될 예정이다. 이를 위해 기획예산처는 초과 세수를 재원으로 전용 기금을 신설하는 방안을 검토 중이다. ‘미래 세대 투자’라는 특정 목적을 위해 쓸 수 있는 ‘돈주머니’에 세수 증가분을 담아 활용한다는 복안이다. 정부 관계자는 “세입이 녹록지 않을 땐 고정된 의무지출 때문에 미래 성장 투자 관점의 재량지출을 크게 늘리기 어렵다”며 “기금으로 칸막이가 있으면 이런 문제가 해소될 수 있다”고 말했다.)

A 'Korean-style national wealth fund' worth 20 trillion won plus alpha will also be utilized separately from the fund. The Korean-style national wealth fund, whose establishment bill is expected to be announced this month, is a model where the government invests its assets in future industries and growth companies to increase fiscal resources. This means the state can also engage in equity investments in future strategic industries. (20조원+α(알파) 규모 ‘한국형 국부펀드’도 기금과 별개로 활용될 예정이다. 이달 중 설립 법안이 발표될 한국형 국부펀드는 정부가 보유한 자산을 미래 산업 및 성장 기업에 투자해 재정을 늘리는 모델이다. 국가가 미래 전략산업에 대한 지분 투자 등에도 나설 수 있는 셈이다.)

What About K-Shaped Polarization? (케이(K)자형 양극화는 어떻게?)

However, discussions on sharing the warmth from the semiconductor supercycle with society as a whole do not seem to be materializing. Recently, the Korean economy has shown a trend of widening disparities by sector, divided into semiconductor and non-semiconductor, export and domestic demand. This is why Kim Yong-beom, head of the Presidential Office Policy Division, previously proposed a redistribution and welfare plan in the form of a 'national dividend' using the semiconductor-driven tax surplus. However, no further discussion on this has followed. An official from the Ministry of Planning and Budget stated, "We do not approach resolving polarization from a redistribution perspective. Reinvesting in other industries to prevent the K-shaped growth between industries from becoming entrenched is also a way to address polarization." (다만 반도체 초호황으로 인한 온기를 사회 전체에 나누는 방안에 대한 논의는 좀체 구체화되지 않는 모양새다. 최근 한국 경제는 반도체와 비반도체, 수출과 내수 등 영역을 나눠 계층별 격차가 확대되는 추세를 보인다. 앞서 김용범 대통령실 정책실장이 반도체발 초과 세수를 활용한 ‘국민배당금’ 형태의 재분배·복지 방안을 제안한 까닭이다. 다만 이에 대한 추가 논의는 이어지지 않고 있다. 기획처 관계자도 “양극화 해소를 재분배 관점에서 접근하지는 않는다. 산업 간 케이자형 성장이 굳어지지 않도록 다른 산업에 재투자하는 것 역시 양극화 해소 방안”이라고 말했다.)

Instead, the government plans to strengthen support for youth employment and job polarization caused by AI. This means responding to the shock of AI transition while working to narrow labor market gaps. The Ministry of Planning and Budget announced that in next year's budget proposal, it will provide benefits such as preferential subsidy rates and lower policy loan interest rates to companies with strong new hiring records. It will offer more incentives for hiring youth and local talent, and provide activity allowances and labor costs for small and medium-sized enterprises and small business owners that hire young talent. (대신 정부는 청년 고용 문제와 인공지능으로 인한 일자리 양극화에 대한 지원은 강화한다는 방침이다. 인공지능 전환으로 인한 충격에 대응하면서 노동시장의 격차 완화에 나선다는 뜻이다. 기획처는 내년도 예산안에 신규 채용 실적이 우수한 기업에 보조율 우대, 정책자금 금리 인하 등의 혜택을 제공하겠다고 밝혔다. 청년·지방 인재 채용 땐 인센티브를 더 많이 지원하고, 중소기업·소상공인 등이 청년 인재를 채용하는 경우 활동 수당 및 인건비도 지원한다는 것이다.)

Experts point out that measures to allow society to share the profits from future growth investments should also be discussed. Woo Seok-jin, a professor of economics at Myongji University, said, "This year could be the starting year of inequality, with the bonus controversy and stock market boom widening income and asset gaps," adding, "We need to consider creating a system for feedback, not just reinvesting all investment profits from the national wealth fund, but also using them for social safety nets." Some experts also raise the need for discussions on introducing a 'surplus profit sharing plan,' similar to the CHIPS Act provision that requires semiconductor companies receiving direct government subsidies to share up to 75% of 'windfall excess profits' exceeding expectations with the U.S. government. (향후 미래 성장 투자에 따른 이익을 사회가 공유할 수 있도록 하는 방안도 함께 논의해야 한다는 지적이 나온다. 우석진 명지대 교수(경제학)는 “성과급 논란과 주식 활황으로 올해는 소득과 자산 격차가 확대되는 불평등 원년이 될 수 있다”며 “국부펀드 등에 따른 투자 이익을 온전히 재투자만 하는 것이 아니라 사회안전망 마련 등에 쓸 수 있도록 환류하는 제도를 만드는 고민이 필요하다”고 말했다. 정부의 직접 보조금을 받는 반도체 기업이 예상치를 크게 웃도는 ‘횡재성 초과이익’을 낼 경우, 보조금의 최대 75%를 미국 정부와 공유하도록 한 칩스법 조항과 유사한 ‘초과이익 공유 방안’ 신설 등 논의가 이어져야 한다는 지적도 전문가들 사이에서 제기된다.)

Park Su-ji, Reporter suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Record-breaking Semiconductor Tax Surplus… Government Invests as Foundation for ‘Second Memory’ (역대급 반도체 초과세수…정부 ‘제2의 메모리’ 밑거름 투입)
item.description:
As President Lee Jae-myung mentioned plans to invest the excess tax revenue from the semiconductor industry into future growth engines, the government has initiated a shift in its overall fiscal management framework for the productive use of the astronomical "semiconductor tax revenue." It has decided to pursue a plan to allocate the expected increase in tax revenue—projected to exceed 100 trillion won in corporate taxes next year alone compared to this year—into a separate fund to be used for investment in the three core components of physical artificial intelligence (AI) and the discovery of future growth engines. Additionally, to enable flexible fiscal management, the government appears to be sequentially initiating improvements in various expenditure areas, such as the local education subsidy and basic pension, which were previously rigidly disbursed according to law. (이재명 대통령이 반도체 산업의 초과세수를 미래 성장동력에 투자하는 방안을 언급하면서, 정부가 천문학적 ‘반도체 세수’의 생산적 활용을 위한 큰 틀의 재정 운용 변화에 시동을 걸고 나섰다. 내년에만 올해보다 법인세가 100조원 이상 더 걷힐 것으로 예상되는 세수 증가분을 피지컬 인공지능(AI) 3대 핵심 부품 투자 및 미래 성장동력 발굴에 쓰도록 별도 기금에 담는 방안을 추진하기로 했다. 또 탄력적인 재정 운용을 위해 법령에 따라 경직적으로 지출되던 지방교육재정교부금·기초연금 등 각종 지출 분야에 대한 개선 작업도 잇따라 착수하는 모양새다.)

The government is moving quickly to establish a physical AI ecosystem to sustain the semiconductor super-boom. On the 9th, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yoon-cheol stated that on the 4th, he held a meeting with industry, academic, and research institute officials related to "sensor semiconductors" to discuss measures for fostering the sensor sector. This follows Koo’s recent identification of "sensor semiconductors" as the second memory semiconductor, after which follow-up discussions have commenced. Participants agreed on the need to "select items in the sensor sector where Korea can become number one and invest intensively," and decided to narrow down specific products. A senior government official emphasized, "Along with GPUs (inference), memory (storage), power semiconductors (cooling), and actuators (joints), sensors (sensory organs) are core components of the future robotics and AI industry. GPUs and memory are markets where winners have already been decided. We will actively utilize the tax revenue increase so that a second memory can emerge from the remaining three product categories." (정부는 반도체 초호황을 이어가기 위해 피지컬 인공지능 생태계 조성에 빠르게 움직이고 있다. 9일 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관은 지난 4일 ‘센서 반도체’ 관련 산업계·학계·연구소 관계자들과 간담회를 열고 센서 분야 육성 방안을 논의했다고 밝혔다. 구 부총리가 최근 ‘센서 반도체’를 제2의 메모리 반도체로 지목한 뒤 후속 논의에 나선 것이다. 참석자들은 “센서 중에서도 한국이 1등 할 수 있는 아이템을 선별해 집중 투자하자”는 취지로 의견을 모으고 구체적인 품목을 추려나가기로 했다. 정부 고위 관계자는 “지피유(GPU·추론), 메모리(기억), 전력반도체(냉각), 액추에이터(관절)와 함께 센서(감각기관)가 미래 로봇·인공지능 산업의 핵심 부품”이라며 “지피유와 메모리는 승자가 결정된 시장인데, 나머지 3개 품목에서 제2의 메모리가 탄생할 수 있도록 세수 증가분을 적극 활용하겠다”고 강조했다.)

The government plans not only to invest research and development resources in the budget but also to create a long-term investment platform for future generations by allocating budget to a Korean sovereign wealth fund or a dedicated fund. Specific measures are expected to be reflected in the government’s second-half economic growth strategy, to be announced from late this month to early July, and in next year’s budget. It will also fully undertake reforms to the local education subsidy and basic pension payments, which had been delayed due to interest group adjustments or public opinion pressures. (정부는 예산안에 연구개발 재원 등을 투자하는 데 그치지 않고, 한국형 국부펀드 또는 전용 기금에 예산을 투입해 미래 세대를 위한 장기 투자 플랫폼을 만든다는 구상이다. 구체적 방안은 정부가 이달 말~7월 초 발표할 하반기 경제성장전략과 내년도 예산안에 반영될 예정이다. 그동안 이해관계 조정이나 여론 부담 때문에 손대지 못했던 지방교육재정교부금과 기초연금 지급 개편에도 본격적으로 나선다.)

Park Soo-ji, Reporter suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: This Year's Tax Revenue Expected to Increase by 50 Trillion Won... Next Year's Budget Projected to Surpass 800 Trillion Won for the First Time (올해 세수 50조원 늘어날 듯…내년 예산 첫 800조원 돌파 전망)
item.description:
Observations suggest that due to the semiconductor boom, this year's excess tax revenue could increase by about 50 trillion won compared to the original budget. With forecasts indicating that next year's corporate tax revenue will rise by over 100 trillion won compared to this year, the budget for next year is expected to surpass 800 trillion won for the first time in history. The tax revenue increase driven by semiconductors appears to be upgrading the government's fiscal scale by one level. (반도체 초호황으로 올해 초과 세수가 본예산 대비 50조원가량 늘어날 수 있다는 관측이 나온다. 내년에도 법인세수가 올해보다 100조원 이상 늘어난다는 전망이 나오면서 내년 예산은 사상 처음 800조원을 돌파할 것으로 보인다. 반도체발 세수 증가분이 정부의 재정 규모 자체를 한 단계 업그레이드하는 모양새다.)

Earlier, when drawing up the supplementary budget in March, the government predicted that this year's national tax revenue would reach 415.4 trillion won, 25.2 trillion won more than initially forecast in the original budget (390.2 trillion won). With major companies' first-quarter results exceeding expectations, it is widely believed that the forecast for corporate tax revenue in this year's supplementary budget (101.3 trillion won) will be significantly surpassed. The expansion of performance bonuses leads to an increase in earned income tax, and the stock market boom could further boost securities transaction tax and the special tax for rural development. As of April this year, national tax revenue stood at 164 trillion won, up 21.9 trillion won from the same period last year, with the progress rate at 39.5%, exceeding the average of previous years (38.6%). <<> Global investment bank Citibank recently estimated in a report that, beyond the supplementary budget drawn up based on March's excess tax revenue predictions, there will be an additional 20 trillion won in excess tax revenue this year. In this case, this year's tax revenue would increase by 45.2 trillion won from the original budget to 435.4 trillion won. They also forecast that next year's corporate tax collection will be 120 trillion won more than this year's tax revenue. A Ministry of Economy and Finance official stated on the 9th, "After reviewing the provisional settlement of corporate tax mid-year payments in August, we can provide a detailed forecast of excess tax revenue." <<> Considering the tax revenue trend and the government's active fiscal stance, the total expenditure in next year's budget proposal is likely to exceed 800 trillion won. According to the medium-term fiscal plan for 2025-2029, next year's fiscal expenditure is set at 764.4 trillion won, a 5.0% increase from this year's original budget (727.9 trillion won), but it appears this will be far surpassed. Moreover, with this year's nominal GDP growth rate projected to reach 10%, the burden of fiscal soundness has been alleviated. As the nominal growth rate reflecting prices rises, the tax revenue outlook improves, and since the denominator of the national debt ratio—GDP—grows, the national debt ratio also declines. <<> However, voices call for reform because, without revising the National Fiscal Act, a significant portion of the excess tax revenue must be used for local and education finances and national debt repayment. If a second supplementary budget is not drawn up, after the settlement next April, local allocation taxes (19.24%) and local education finance grants (20.79%) must be settled first, and then at least 30% of the remaining amount must be used for public funds and national debt repayment. President Lee Jae-myung stated at a press conference marking the first anniversary of his inauguration on the 8th, "Paying off debt with excess tax revenue is foolish." <<> Reporter Park Su-ji suji@hani.co.kr (앞서 정부는 지난 3월 추가경정예산안을 편성하면서 올해 국세수입이 애초 본예산 때 전망(390조2천억원)보다 25조2천억원 더 걷힌 415조4천억원이 될 것으로 예상했다. 여기에 주요 기업들의 1분기 실적이 기대를 웃돌면서 올해 추경 기준 법인세 수입 전망(101조3천억원)도 크게 뛰어넘을 것이라는 관측이 지배적이다. 성과급 확대는 근로소득세 증가로 나타나고, 증시 활황으로 증권거래세와 농어촌특별세도 더 늘어날 수 있다. 올해 4월까지 국세수입은 164조원으로 전년 동기 대비 21조9천억원 증가했으며, 진도율도 39.5%로 예년 평균(38.6%)을 웃돌고 있다.)

item.title: Hanssem, Interior Specialist, Renovates Homes for the Underprivileged… Reaches Cumulative Milestone of 1,000 Units (인테리어 전문기업 한샘의 소외계층 집 고쳐주기…누적 ‘1000호’ 기록 썼다)
item.description:
The "Space Sharing" social contribution activities of home interior specialist Hanssem, aimed at supporting the underprivileged, have reached a cumulative milestone of 1,000 units, drawing attention. (홈 인테리어 전문기업 한샘의 소외계층 공간나눔 사회공헌 활동이 누적 ‘1천호’ 기록을 세워 눈길을 끈다.)

Hanssem announced on the 9th that its space sharing activities, which began in 2013 through volunteer work by its in-house club "Hanultari," have recently achieved a cumulative record of 1,000 units. Leveraging the characteristics of an interior specialty company, this initiative involves renovating the homes of those in need, including underprivileged families, children with incurable diseases, families of firefighters who died in the line of duty, and independence activists, establishing itself as a flagship social contribution program for Hanssem. Recently, the scope has expanded to include remodeling public facilities such as children and youth welfare centers, elderly care facilities, and fire stations. <<> This year, Hanssem selected "women and vulnerable groups" as key support targets. In February, in collaboration with the international development NGO J-Foundation and space consulting firm Oyus Co., Ltd., it carried out the first project of a space improvement initiative for a visually impaired woman's home. During the approximately month-long renovation period, Hanssem remodeled the entire house, paying extra attention to the kitchen and bathroom, which could pose risks for the visually impaired woman and her children. The bathroom utilized the 'EasyBath' product, which has no gaps for easy cleaning and features a non-slip floor surface. <<> A Hanssem official stated, "Beyond simply replacing furniture and renovating interiors, the significance of Hanssem's space improvement project lies in helping our marginalized neighbors regain a peaceful daily life," adding, "We will continue to strive to spread the value of social sharing as a home interior specialist company." <<> Senior Reporter Choi Jong-hoon cjhoon@hani.co.kr ( 한샘은 사내 동아리 ‘한울타리’의 봉사활동으로 지난 2013년 시작된 자사의 공간나눔 활동이 최근 누적 ‘1000호’ 기록을 달성했다고 9일 밝혔다. 이 활동은 인테리어 전문기업의 특성을 살려 소외계층 가정, 난치병 어린이, 순직 소방공무원 가족, 독립유공자 등 도움이 필요한 이웃들의 보금자리를 새롭게 단장하는 것으로, 한샘의 대표적인 사회공헌 활동으로 자리매김했다. 최근에는 아동·청소년 복지시설, 노인 요양시설, 소방서 등 공공시설 리모델링으로 범위를 넓혀가고 있는 중이다.)

item.title: LCCs Hit Hard by High Oil Prices and Exchange Rates: "It Wouldn’t Be Strange If They Close Next Month" (고유가·고환율 직격타 맞은 LCC..“다음 달 문닫아도 이상하지 않을 상황”)
item.description:
The prolonged war between the US, Israel, and Iran has led to sustained high oil prices, and recently, the high exchange rate has added to the burden on the domestic aviation industry. While major airlines are managing to defend their performance through alternative demand inflows and cargo operations, low-cost carriers (LCCs) are seeing their profitability deteriorate due to rising fuel costs and exchange rate pressures. Particularly, some new LCCs are reportedly in a position where they must fear for their survival as passenger numbers decline. (미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 장기화로 고유가 국면이 지속되고 최근 고환율까지 겹치면서 국내 항공업계의 경영 부담이 가중되고 있다. 그나마 대형 항공사는 대체 수요 유입과 화물 사업으로 실적 방어에 나서고 있지만, 저비용항공사(LCC)는 연료비 부담과 환율 부담이 커지면서 수익성이 악화하는 모습이다. 특히 일부 신생 저비용항공사의 경우, 탑승객 감소로 생존을 우려해야 할 처지에 놓였다는 평가도 나온다.)

The current combination of high oil prices and high exchange rates is burdensome for all airlines. The exchange rate fluctuations are particularly concerning. Last night, during the Seoul foreign exchange market’s overnight trading, the won-dollar exchange rate rose to as high as 1,561.5 won per dollar during the day, marking the highest level in 17 years and 3 months since March 2009, during the global financial crisis. Since aviation fuel, aircraft lease payments, and maintenance costs are settled in dollars, rising oil prices and exchange rates directly lead to increased costs for airlines. In its recent annual report, the International Air Transport Association (IATA) forecasted that the global aviation industry’s net profit this year would only be half of 2025’s projected level (approximately $45 billion). ( 고유가에 고환율까지 겹친 현재 상황은 모든 항공사에 부담이다. 특히 환율 변동이 심상치 않다. 지난 6일 새벽 서울 외환시장 야간거래에서 원·달러 환율은 장중 달러당 1561.5원까지 오르며 글로벌 금융위기 때인 2009년 3월 이후 17년3개월 만에 최고 수준을 기록했다. 항공유와 항공기 리스료, 정비비 등을 달러로 결제하는 만큼 유가와 환율 상승은 항공사에 곧 비용 증가로 이어진다. 국제항공운송협회(IATA)는 최근 발표한 연례보고서에서 올해 글로벌 항공업계의 순이익이 2025년(약 450억달러)의 절반 수준에 그칠 것으로 전망했다.)

However, the intensity of the impact will inevitably differ between major airlines and LCCs. Major airlines have a lower proportion of leased aircraft and relatively stronger in-house maintenance capabilities. They also use fuel hedging contracts, which lock in future fuel prices in advance, allowing them to partially offset the rise in oil prices. An industry insider noted, "Unlike major airlines, LCCs have limited means to buffer against cost increases, so they are directly exposed to the impact of rising oil prices and exchange rates." ( 다만, 대형항공사와 저비용항공사가 받을 충격의 강도는 다를 수밖에 없다. 대형항공사는 리스 비중이 낮은 데다 상대적으로 자체 정비 역량을 갖추고 있고, 미래의 연료 가격을 미리 고정해 두는 연료 헤지 계약을 활용해 유가 상승분을 일부 상쇄할 수 있기 때문이다. 항공업계 한 관계자는 “대형항공사와 달리 비용 증가를 완충할 수단이 제한적인 저비용항공사는 유가와 환율(상승) 충격을 직접 맞을 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

The difference in load factors also supports this situation. For LCCs, declining passenger numbers are causing seat occupancy rates to fall, further reducing the leeway to offset cost burdens. According to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport’s Aviation Information Portal on the 9th, major airlines like Korean Air and Asiana Airlines (FSCs) have maintained load factors in the mid-80% range from March to May. Korean Air recorded load factors of 86.2% in March, 89.2% in April, and 85.6% in May, while Asiana Airlines saw 83.6%, 89.6%, and 84.4% during the same period—similar to or slightly higher than the previous year. This is believed to be due to global demand shifting to major airlines as Middle Eastern carriers face operational disruptions. In the aviation industry, the breakeven load factor is typically around 80%. ( 특히 탑승률 차이도 이런 상황을 뒷받침한다. 저비용항공사의 경우, 탑승객 감소로 좌석 점유율이 떨어지면서 비용 부담을 상쇄할 여지도 줄어드는 상황이다. 9일 국토교통부의 항공정보 포털시스템을 보면, 대한항공과 아시아나항공 등 대형항공사(FSC)는 지난 3~5월 80% 중반을 웃도는 탑승률을 유지하고 있다. 대한항공의 탑승률은 3월 86.2%, 4월 89.2%, 5월 85.6%를 기록했고, 아시아나항공도 같은 기간 83.6%, 89.6%, 84.4%로 집계됐다. 지난해 같은 기간과 비슷하거나 소폭 오른 수준이다. 중동 항공사의 운항 차질로 글로벌 수요가 대형 항공사로 옮겨온 영향으로 풀이된다. 통상 항공업계에서는 손익분기점 탑승률을 80% 정도로 본다.)

In contrast, the load factor of new LCCs is worsening. For Air Ro Korea, based in Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province, the load factor dropped from 77.24% in March to 73.77% in April, and further fell to 69.7% in May when the highest fuel surcharge level was applied. This appears to reflect both a decrease in outbound passenger demand due to rising ticket prices and exchange rate burdens, and the sensitivity of LCC passengers to price fluctuations. As a result, airlines face an unavoidable decline in profitability due to empty seats with every flight. ( 반면, 신생 저비용항공사의 탑승률은 악화하고 있다. 충북 청주 지역을 기반으로 하는 에어로케이의 탑승률은 지난 3월 77.24%에서 4월 73.77%로 하락한 데 이어, 유류할증료 최고단계가 적용된 5월에는 69.7%까지 떨어졌다. 항공권 가격 상승과 환율 부담으로 국외로 나가려는 여객 수요가 줄어든데다, 가격 변동폭에 민감한 저비용항공사 탑승객의 성향이 반영된 결과로 보인다. 비행기를 띄울수록 좌석 공실에 따른 수익성 악화가 불가피한 상황에 직면한 것이다.)

This has raised concerns in the aviation industry that some LCCs with weak financial capacity may struggle to survive independently and could soon be put up for sale. An LCC industry insider said, "During the COVID-19 period, there was support like employment retention subsidies and infrastructure stabilization funds, but now airlines are essentially fending for themselves. Some are barely hanging on, but those with poor financial conditions are in such a difficult state that it wouldn't be strange if they closed next month without continued government support." ( 이 때문에 항공 업계에서는 재무 여력이 취약한 일부 저비용항공사의 경우, 독자 생존이 어려워 조만간 시장에 매물로 나올 수 있다는 우려도 제기된다. 한 저비용항공사 관계자는 “코로나19 시기에는 고용유지지원금과 기간산업안정기금 등의 지원이 있었지만 현재는 사실상 항공사들이 각자도생하고 있다”며 “어떻게든 버티고 있으나 재무 여건이 좋지 않은 항공사들은 정부 지원이 계속 없다면 다음 달 문을 닫더라도 이상하지 않을 정도로 어려운 상황”이라고 말했다.)

By Seo Hyemi, ham@hani.co.kr, and Lee Jubin, yes@hani.co.kr ( 서혜미 기자 ham@hani.co.kr, 이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: National Tax Revenue Fluctuates with Semiconductor Industry Cycle… Now Is the "Right Time to Expand the Tax Base" (반도체 업황에 널뛰는 국세수입…지금이 “과세 기반 확충 적기”)
item.description:
As the transition to artificial intelligence (AI) accelerates across industries, calls are growing to fundamentally overhaul the existing tax system to address social issues such as job losses and inequality caused by this shift. There is also a practical problem: the current tax revenue structure, which fluctuates with the boom and bust cycles of specific industries like semiconductors, makes it difficult to stably secure funding for ongoing expenditure needs such as welfare and social safety nets. Moreover, with no nationwide elections until the 2028 general election, following the 9th local elections held on the 3rd, the next two years are seen as an opportune time to push for tax reforms aimed at expanding the tax base. (산업 전반에서 인공지능(AI) 전환이 빨라지는 가운데 이에 따른 일자리 감소, 양극화 등 사회 문제를 해결하기 위해 기존의 과세 체계를 근본적으로 바꿔야 한다는 주장이 힘을 얻고 있다. 반도체 등 특정 산업의 호·불황에 따라 출렁거리는 현행 세입 구조로는 복지와 사회안전망 등 지속적인 재원 투입이 필요한 지출을 안정적으로 확보하기 어렵다는 현실적인 문제도 있다. 더구나 지난 3일 치러진 제9대 지방선거 뒤 2028년 총선까지 향후 2년간 전국 단위 선거도 없는 시기여서, 과세 기반을 확충하는 세제 개편에 나설 적기라는 평가도 나온다.)

In recent years, national tax revenue has been significantly influenced by the semiconductor market's performance. According to the Ministry of Economy and Finance's national tax revenue statistics, about 60% of last year's increase in national tax revenue (37.4 trillion won) came from an increase in corporate tax (22.1 trillion won). Earlier, during the COVID-19 period, the growth of the non-face-to-face and remote work sectors boosted the semiconductor industry, leading to corporate tax revenues of 103.6 trillion won and total national tax revenues of 395.9 trillion won in 2022. However, as the semiconductor industry slowed in 2024, corporate tax revenues shrank to 62.5 trillion won and total national tax revenues to 336.5 trillion won. This shows that if the semiconductor industry declines, fiscal conditions may also worsen. <<> For this reason, experts point out that instead of resting on the current tax revenue boom, it is necessary to establish a sustainable tax base through spending restructuring and other measures. Lee Sang-min, a senior research fellow at the National Budget & Policy Institute, stated, "With the semiconductor sector's solo growth, only certain companies, their related workers, and those who invested in them will make money," adding, "To secure resources to alleviate polarization, we should review tax expenditure adjustments, such as converting tax expenditures (reducing taxes owed through exemptions, etc.) into fiscal spending (direct government spending on welfare programs, etc. using tax revenue)." The idea is to reduce tax exemptions to strengthen the revenue base and use those funds for redistribution policies. <<> There are also calls to raise South Korea's tax burden ratio, which is lower than the OECD average. The tax burden ratio, which measures tax revenue as a share of Gross Domestic Product (GDP), stood at 17.6% in South Korea in 2024, 7.3 percentage points lower than the OECD average of 24.9%. <<> Some opinions suggest exploring changes to the framework of the tax law itself. People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy recently sent a "Tax Law Amendment Opinion" to the Ministry of Economy and Finance, stating, "The current income tax system operates by enumerating taxable income, leading to tax gaps for new forms of income. A comprehensive principle should be introduced, taxing based on economic capacity regardless of the source or form of income." South Korea follows the enumerative principle, where taxes can only be imposed on items listed in the law. The intent is to consider shifting the legislative approach to a comprehensive principle, like Japan's, where income is generally subject to taxation upon occurrence. <<> Discussions also seem necessary on reviewing new tax systems to address the long-term issue of AI replacing human labor. In Silicon Valley, the forefront of AI technology development in the U.S., discussions on a robot tax began around 2017, when the "Fourth Industrial Revolution" discourse emerged before COVID-19. At the time, Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates argued that "if robots replace humans, the users of the robots should be taxed at an income tax level." More recently, in April, OpenAI proposed in a policy paper introducing a "tax related to automated labor," meaning a tax on cost savings and profits from introducing robots. <<> Related research is also underway in South Korea. In a 2024 report titled "Plan for Introducing a Robot Tax in Response to the Fourth Industrial Revolution," the Korea Local Finance Association suggested imposing local acquisition tax on companies that acquire robots (mechanical devices). Earlier, in a 2018 report titled "Technological Development and Future Tax System," the Korea Institute of Public Finance proposed a phased imposition of a robot tax based on the level of robot development. <<> However, there are counterarguments that discussions on additional taxes like a robot tax could stifle corporate technological development. At a press conference the previous day, President Lee Jae-myung emphasized the need for discussion at the international level regarding profit-sharing measures like a robot tax, stating, "If we adopt it first on our own, advanced foreign companies will hesitate to invest in Korea, and domestic companies will also be reluctant to invest." <<> Shin Min-jeong, Park Su-ji, Kim Yun-ju Reporters shin@hani.co.kr ( 최근 수년간 국세수입은 반도체 경기 호조의 영향을 크게 받고 있다. 재정경제부의 국세수입 통계를 보면, 지난해 국세수입은 증가분(37조4천억원)의 약 60%가 법인세 증가분(22조1천억원)이었다. 앞서 코로나19 시기 비대면·재택근무로 반도체 산업이 커진 결과 2022년 법인세는 103조6천억원, 총국세는 395조9천억원에 달했는데, 2024년 반도체 산업이 둔화하면서 법인세는 62조5천억원, 총국세는 336조5천억원으로 쪼그라든 바 있다. 반도체 산업이 꺾이면 재정 여건도 같이 어려워질 수 있다는 걸 보여준다.)

item.title: The Future That Arrived First… What the Seoul Mayoral Election Results Tell Us (먼저 온 미래…서울시장 선거 결과가 말하는 것)
item.description:
The Seoul mayoral election is over, but the questions left by its results are not. If one attempts to read this election merely as one candidate’s victory and another’s defeat, that would be a one-dimensional interpretation. What signals should the political sphere read from these local election results? Let us interpret those signals from the perspective of the ruling Democratic Party. The ruling party remained strong in Gyeonggi and Incheon, swept the metropolitan government positions in the Chungcheong region—Korea’s “swing voter area”—and even won in Busan and Ulsan, which had seemed difficult. Furthermore, in Daegu and South Gyeongsang, where the population and industrial structure have made it as conservative as possible, the party, though narrowly defeated, obtained more votes than in the past. (서울시장 선거는 끝났지만, 그 결과가 남긴 질문은 끝나지 않았다. 이번 선거를 단순히 한 후보의 승리와 다른 후보의 패배로만 읽으려 한다면 이는 일차원적 독해다. 지방 선거 결과로부터 정치권이 읽어내야 할 신호는 무엇일까? 집권 여당인 민주당 입장에서 그 신호를 해석해보자. 여당은 경기와 인천에서는 여전히 강했고, 한국의 ‘스윙보터 지역’인 충청 지역 광역 단체장을 싹쓸이했으며, 더 나아가 쉽지 않아 보이던 부산·울산도 승리했다. 심지어 인구와 산업구조상 보수의 색채가 짙어질 때로 짙어진 대구·경남에서도 비록 석패했지만 과거보다 더 많은 표를 얻었다.)

Then, should they laugh? However, there is one decisive fact that overturns the sentiment of all these results: the party lost the Seoul mayoral election. This Seoul mayoral election has brought back two weaknesses of the Democratic Party that were temporarily obscured by the excitement and fervor of the presidential election held after the impeachment. One is a generational rift centered on men in their 20s and 30s, and the other is the revival of real estate politics surrounding Seoul apartments. ( 그렇다면 웃어야 할까? 그러나 이 모든 결과의 소감을 바꾸어버리는 결정적 사실이 하나 있다. 바로 서울 시장 선거에서 패배했다는 점이다. 이번 서울 시장 선거는 탄핵 이후 치러진 대통령 선거의 흥분과 열기에 잠시 가려졌던 민주당의 두 가지 약점을 다시 끄집어냈다. 하나는 20·30대 남성을 축으로 한 세대 균열이고, 다른 하나는 서울 아파트를 둘러싼 부동산 정치의 부활이다. )

■ Generational Rift Led by Men in Their 20s and 30s ( ■ 20·30대 남성층이 주도하는 세대 균열 )

First, consider the issue of men in their 20s and 30s. The fact that they were favorable toward Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, is not particularly surprising given their previous voting tendencies. Already in the 2022 presidential election, men in their 20s had clearly expressed their political preferences and were recognized as a group that influenced the election outcome. What this result has shown more clearly is that the trend of men in their 20s—who were enthusiastic about candidate Lee Jun-seok in the last presidential election and ultimately supported Yoon Seok-yeol—is not a one-time phenomenon inherent in a specific cohort, but a generational characteristic of young men overall. This characteristic was not very noticeable in the 2025 presidential election but became visible in this Seoul mayoral election, because the Reform Party’s Seoul mayoral candidate in this local election was not one who could disperse the votes of the 20s like candidate Lee Jun-seok did in the last presidential election. In fact, in last year’s presidential election, candidate Lee Jae-myung took first place in approval ratings in Seoul, but his vote share was lower than the sum of votes for candidate Kim Moon-soo and candidate Lee Jun-seok. Even in the 2022 presidential election, when conservatives and progressives united for a “real showdown,” candidate Lee Jae-myung trailed candidate Yoon Seok-yeol in Seoul. Rather, candidate Jeong Won-oh of the Democratic Party had a higher vote share this time than candidate Lee Jae-myung did in both presidential elections. He lost because his vote share still fell short of the sum of the Reform Party candidate’s and Oh Se-hoon’s vote shares. (Even if calculated as “broad progressive,” including the Justice Party, the result does not change.) ( 먼저 20·30대 남성 문제를 보자. 이들이 오세훈 국민의힘 후보에 우호적이라는 사실 자체는 이들의 이전 투표 성향에 비추어 그다지 놀라운 일은 아니다. 이미 2022년 대선에서 20대 남성은 자신의 정치적 선호를 분명히 했고 선거 결과를 좌우한 집단으로 인정받았다. 이번 결과가 한층 분명히 보여준 것은, 지난 대선에서 이준석 후보에게 열광하고 끝내 윤석열을 지지했던 20대 남성들의 흐름이 특정 코호트에 내재된 일회성 현상이 아니라, 젊은 남성 전반의 세대적 특성이라는 사실이다. 이러한 특성은 2025년 대통령 선거에서는 그다지 눈에 띄지 않았지만 이번 서울시장 선거에서 가시화되었는데, 이는 이번 지방선거에 출마한 개혁신당의 서울시장 후보가 지난 대선 당시 이준석 후보처럼 20대의 표를 분산시킬 만한 후보가 아니었다는 데 있다. 사실 지난해 대선, 서울에서 이재명 후보는 지지율 1위를 차지했지만 그의 득표율은, 김문수 후보와 이준석 후보의 득표율 합보다 낮았다. 보수와 진보가 총 결집하여 ‘진검승부’를 펼친 22년 대선에서도 서울에서 이재명 후보는 윤석열 후보에게 뒤처졌다. 오히려 더불어민주당 정원오 후보의 이번 득표율은 두 대선에서 이재명 후보보다 높았다. 그가 패배한 것은 그의 득표율이 개혁신당 후보와 오세훈 후보의 득표율의 합에는 여전히 미치지 못했기 때문이다. (정의당을 포함한 ‘범진보’로 계산해도 결과는 달라지지 않는다.) )

In three of the last four elections, the Democratic Party candidate’s vote share has been capped at a maximum of 45-48%, and each time, when conservative and third-zone votes combined, the party inevitably hit the majority barrier. Therefore, as long as the conservative-progressive landscape remains tight and Seoul’s age structure maintains its current pattern, it will be difficult for the Democratic Party to reclaim the Seoul mayoral position. (Conversely, from the People Power Party’s perspective, as long as a unified conservative candidate is maintained, elections in Seoul seem favorable.) Rather, considering that Seoul concentrates universities and large corporate jobs, causing the proportion of voters in their 20s to continue increasing, it seems reasonable to view the Democratic Party’s disadvantage in Seoul as structural. ( 최근 4차례 선거 가운데 3번의 선거에서 민주당 후보의 득표율은 최대 45~48%대에 갇혔고, 보수와 제3지대의 표가 합쳐지는 순간 번번이 과반의 벽에 막혔다는 공통점이 있다. 따라서 지금처럼 보수-진보 구도가 팽팽히 유지되고 서울의 연령구조가 현재의 패턴을 유지하는 한, 민주당의 서울시장 수복은 쉽지 않다. (역으로 국민의힘 입장에서는, 보수 단일 후보가 유지되는 한 서울에서의 선거는 유리해 보인다.) 오히려 서울에 대학과 대기업 일자리가 모여 있어 전체 유권자 중 20대 비중은 계속 증가한다는 점을 고려하면 앞으로 서울에서 민주당이 갖는 열위는 오히려 구조적인 것으로 보는 게 타당해보인다. )

The influence of age structure on political decision-making is very long-term, so once a direction is set, it rarely changes. This is the core of political scientist Ron Inglehart’s concept of the “silent revolution.” His argument is that people establish basic values and norms during childhood, adolescence, and early adulthood, and once formed, these values hardly change afterward. Therefore, changes in the overall values of society are not the result of persuading older generations to adopt new values, but the product of incremental change as older generations disappear and younger generations take their place. It is like the waves of the Yangtze River pushing out the waves ahead; the back and front waves do not mix. Pippa Norris, a professor at Harvard Kennedy School who conducted joint research with Inglehart in his later years, emphasized this simple but often overlooked fact—that changes in values, including political views, occur through “generational replacement” rather than “persuasion,” and once established, generational effects persist for a long time. She likened this process to a rat swallowed by a python slowly passing through its body. This theoretical framework also has implications for how political parties approach male and female voters in their 20s and 30s. Even if the origin of generational disagreements is economic disparity, their persistence may involve issues of collective identity—the perception that “our group is being treated unfairly by the system compared to other groups.” Material compensation alone has clear limits in healing psychological wounds like distrust of the system, perceived breaches of fairness, and relative deprivation. How to address this remains unclear. ( 연령구조가 정치적 의사결정에 미치는 영향력은 매우 장기적이기에 방향이 한번 정해지면 여간해서 바뀌지 않는다. 이것이 정치학자 론 잉글하트(Ron Inglehart)가 말한 ‘조용한 혁명’ 개념의 핵심이다. 그의 논지는 사람들은 유년기와 청소년기, 사회 초년기에 기본 가치관과 규범을 확립하고, 일단 굳어진 가치관은 이후 거의 변하지 않는다는 것이다. 따라서 사회 전체의 가치관 변화는 기존 세대가 새로운 가치관에 설득된 결과가 아니라, 나이 든 세대가 사라지고 그 자리를 젊은 세대가 채운 점진적 변화의 산물이라는 것이다. 장강의 뒷물이 앞물을 밀어내는 것이지, 뒷물과 앞물이 섞이는 것은 아니라는 말이다. 말년의 잉글하트와 공동 연구를 진행한 피파 노리스(Pippa Norris) 하버드대 케네디스쿨 교수는 바로 이 단순하지만 흔히 간과되는 사실 - 정치적 견해를 비롯한 가치관 변화는 ‘설득’이 아닌 ‘세대교체’를 통해 이루어지며 한번 자리 잡은 세대효과는 길게 간다 - 을 강조하며 이 과정을 뱀이 삼킨 쥐가 몸통을 천천히 통과하는 모습(rat in a python)에 비유한 바 있다. 또한 이러한 이론적 프레임은 정당이 20대 남성·여성 유권자에 접근하는 방식에도 함의를 던진다. 세대 간 이견은 그 기원이 경제적 격차일지라도, 그 지속은 ‘타 집단에 비해 우리 집단이 체제로부터 불공정한 대우를 받고 있다’는 집단적 정체성의 문제일 수 있기 때문이다. 물질적 보상만으로는 체제에 대한 불신과 ‘공정성의 훼손과 상대적 박탈감’이라는 심리적 상흔을 치유하는데 한계가 분명하다. 이를 어떻게 다룰 것인가에 대한 해법은 분명하지 않다. )

■ Potential for “Political Gangnamization” Across Seoul ( ■ 서울 전역의 ‘정치적 강남화’ 가능성 )

The second rift is real estate. Candidate Jeong Won-oh narrowly won in many of Seoul’s districts. However, candidate Oh Se-hoon achieved a landslide victory in the Gangnam three districts and the Han River belt, including Yongsan, and that decided the election outcome. The consolidation in these areas is a compressed version of “apartment politics”—expectations for reconstruction and redevelopment, dissatisfaction with property taxes and loan regulations, and experiences of rising apartment prices all converged and expressed very strongly in one direction. The relationship between rising Seoul apartment prices and voting tendencies is confirmed by various data. ( 두 번째 균열은 부동산이다. 정원오 후보는 서울의 다수 자치구에서 신승했다. 그러나 오세훈 후보는 강남 3구와 용산 등의 한강벨트에서 압승했고 그것이 선거 결과를 갈랐다. 이들 지역의 결집은 ‘아파트 정치’의 압축판이다. 재건축·재개발 기대, 보유세 부담, 대출 규제에 대한 불만, 집값 상승의 경험이 모아 한 방향으로 매우 강력하게 표출된 모양새다. 서울의 아파트값 상승과 투표성향에 대한 관계는 여러 데이터를 통해 확인된다. )

According to an analysis by Shin Soo-hyun of the London School of Economics (LSE), which examined the relationship between Seoul’s average official housing price by administrative district and the margin between the Democratic Party and People Power Party vote shares, the higher the average official housing price in an administrative district, the wider the vote gap became in favor of the People Power Party compared to the Democratic Party. Specifically, for every 100 million won increase in the average official price of a district, the Democratic Party’s vote share tended to be about 3 percentage points lower than the People Power Party’s. Notably, this trend appeared not only in areas like the Gangnam three districts but also very consistently in areas with official prices below 900 million won (though the price’s explanatory power for the vote gap is limited). This implies that as Seoul’s “apartment dominance” accelerates, all of Seoul could transform into a “political Gangnam.” ( 행정동 단위로 서울의 평균 주택공시가격과 민주당-국민의힘 득표율 격차 간의 관계를 살핀 런던정경대(LSE) 소속 신수현의 분석에 따르면, 평균 주택공시가격이 더 비싼 행정동일수록 민주당과 국민의힘의 득표율 차이가 민주당에게 불리한 쪽으로 더 벌어졌다. 구체적으로, 행정동의 평균 공시가격이 1억원 높아질 때마다 민주당의 득표율은 국민의힘보다 약 3%포인트씩 더 낮아지는 경향을 보였다. 주목할 점은 이런 경향이 강남 3구 같은 지역뿐 아니라 공시가격 9억원 이하 지역에서도 매우 일관되게 나타난다는 사실이다(다만 가격이 표차를 설명하는 설명력은 떨어진다.) 이는 앞으로 서울 아파트 ‘1강 현상’이 가속화될수록, 서울 전역이 ‘정치적 강남’으로 변화할 수 있음을 의미한다. )

At this very point, the difficulty of the comprehensive real estate tax reform, which will be discussed during the upcoming tax reform process, emerges. Ordinary people often perceive those within the scope of the comprehensive real estate tax as confined to those aged 60 and older, but reality is different. When the Park Geun-hye government began, the average apartment price in Seoul was 520 million won; now it has reached 1.57 billion won. As a result, about half of those subject to the comprehensive real estate tax are already in their 40s and 50s. The relentless rise in housing prices makes those in their 40s and 50s who are not yet subject to the tax—middle-class families, long-term single-homeowners, and dual-income high-earning households—perceive that they cannot be free from its influence. ( 바로 이 지점에서 이번 세제개편 과정에서 논의될 종합부동산세 개혁안의 난제가 튀어나온다. 흔히 일반인들은 종부세의 자장 안에 있는 계층을 60대 이상 고령자로 한정해 인식하지만, 현실은 그렇지 않다. 박근혜 정부 출범 당시 5억2천만원이던 서울 아파트 평균 가격은 지금 15억7천만원에 이르고, 그 결과 종부세 과세대상의 절반가량은 이미 40·50대로 범위를 넓혔다. 거침없는 집값 상승은 아직 종부세 대상이 아닌 40·50대 중산층, 장기 1주택 보유자, 맞벌이 고소득 가구도 그 자장에서 자유로울 수 없다고 인식하게 만든다. )

■ The Comprehensive Real Estate Tax Dilemma and the Meaning of the Seoul Mayoral Election ( ■ 종부세 딜레마와 서울시장 선거의 의미 )

The comprehensive real estate tax has limitations as a policy tool in two respects. Housing prices react much more sensitively to “bank interest rates” or “loan limits” than to taxes. Moreover, since the comprehensive real estate tax cannot track the speed of housing price fluctuations in real time, it has clear limits as a means to stabilize the housing market. In fact, empirical evidence that the tax is effective in curbing price increases is limited. Then, what remains is its significance as a wealth tax, but even this has limitations in achieving horizontal equity due to the current taxation method, which differentiates tax bases based on “number of homes” rather than asset value. Thus, while policy effects remain unproven, the burdened population is expanding, and simply maintaining the status quo conflicts with market expectations and the demands of key support bases. This is why a solution for the comprehensive real estate tax is difficult. Attention is focused on how President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party will break through this challenge. ( 종부세는 다음의 두가지 측면에서 정책 수단으로서 한계가 있는 제도다. 집값은 세금보다 ‘은행 이자’나 ‘대출 한도’에 훨씬 더 민감하게 반응한다. 그런데 종부세는 집값이 오르내리는 속도를 실시간으로 따라가지 못하기에, 주택시장 안정화 수단으로서 한계가 뚜렷하다. 실제로 종부세가 가격 상승을 억제하는 데 효과적이라는 실증적 근거는 제한적이다. 그렇다면 남는 것은 부유세로서의 의의인데 이마저도 자산 가치가 아닌 ‘주택 수’에 따라 과세 기준을 달리하는 현재의 과세 방식으로 인해 수평적 형평성을 달성하는데 한계가 있다. 이처럼 정책 효과는 입증되지 않은 채 부담 계층은 확대되고 있으며, 그렇다고 현상유지를 하자니 시장의 기대와 핵심 지지층의 요구와 충돌한다. 종부세 해법이 어려운 이유도 여기에 있다. 이재명 대통령과 민주당이 이 난제를 어떻게 돌파할 것인가가 주목되는 이유이다. )

Politics is not determined solely by structure. Candidate appeal, election dynamics, the judgment of the incumbent government, and unexpected variables can always sway results. However, because the ruling and opposition forces are closely contested, structural biases cannot be overlooked. Seoul has already laid out the questions for the next election. How each political force responds to and breaks through these challenges will determine the course of the general election in two years and the next presidential election. It is a city where volatility in population and assets, job insecurity, and housing instability condense, and the rifts erupt first in the form of votes. In this sense, Seoul is not merely a post hoc reflection of Korean politics. Rather, it is where the future arrives first. Hence, the results of this Seoul mayoral election represent the “future that arrived first” for Korean politics. ( 정치가 구조만으로 결정되진 않는다. 후보의 매력, 선거 구도, 정권 심판론, 돌발 변수는 언제든 결과를 흔든다. 그러나 여야의 판세가 초접전이기에 구조적 쏠림을 염두에 두지 않을 수 없다. 서울은 이미 다음 선거의 문제지를 펼쳐 보였다. 이 난제를 각 정치 세력이 어떻게 대응하고 돌파하느냐가 내후년의 총선 그리고 다음 대선의 향배를 결정지을 것이다. 인구과 자산의 변동성, 일자리와 주거 불안이 응축되어 그 균열이 가장 먼저 투표로 터지는 도시. 이러한 면에서 서울은 단순히 한국 정치의 사후적 반영체가 아니다. 오히려 그 미래가 가장 먼저 도착하는 곳이다. 그래서 이번 서울시장 선거 결과는 앞으로의 한국 정치를 보여주는 ‘먼저 온 미래’다.)

Choi Han-soo, Professor at Kyungpook National University (Economics) ( 최한수 경북대 교수(경제학))

item.title: Student Numbers Drop by 1 Million, Budget Rises by 33 Trillion Won… Attempt to Reform Education Grant Tied to 20.79% of Domestic Taxes (학생수 100만명↓ 예산은 33조↑…‘내국세 20.79% 연동’ 교육교부금 개편 시도)
item.description:
As calls grow to invest semiconductor-driven surplus tax revenue in future projects, discussions are reigniting over reforming the allocation method of Local Education Financial Grants (education grants), which currently distribute a fixed portion of domestic taxes uniformly. (반도체발 초과세수를 미래 투자에 쓰자는 요구가 커지면서 내국세의 일정 부분을 떼어 일률 배분하는 지방교육재정교부금(교육교부금) 지급 방식을 개편해야 한다는 논의도 다시 본격화하고 있다.)

Currently, education grants allocate 20.79% of domestic taxes and part of education taxes to provincial and municipal education offices for use in elementary and secondary education. This system was introduced in 1972 to ensure stable funding for education. Over the past 50-plus years, the school-age population has declined, yet education grants have surged, drawing persistent criticism. In fact, education grants grew from 43 trillion won in 2016 to 76 trillion won this year, including supplementary budgets. Meanwhile, the number of elementary and secondary school students fell from 5.96 million to 4.92 million over the same period. Rigidly distributing tax revenue increases driven by the semiconductor boom inevitably hinders the efficiency of fiscal management, which aims to allocate limited budgets appropriately. Previously, during the post-COVID boom years of 2021 and 2022, semiconductor-driven surplus tax revenue caused sudden increases in education grants, sparking controversy over wasteful spending. ( 현재 교육교부금은 내국세의 20.79%와 교육세 일부를 시·도교육청에 이전해 초중고교 교육에 쓰는 구조다. 1972년 당시 교육 재원을 안정적으로 확보하기 위해 도입했다. 50여년이 지나는 동안 학령인구는 감소하는데 교육교부금은 넘쳐난다는 지적이 꾸준히 제기돼왔다. 실제로 교육교부금 규모는 2016년 43조원에서 올해 추가경정예산 포함 76조원으로 늘었다. 같은 기간 초중고 학생은 596만명에서 492만명으로 줄었다. 반도체 초호황으로 인한 세수 증가분을 경직적으로 분배할 경우, 한정된 예산을 적재적소에 투입한다는 재정 운용의 효율성에 걸림돌이 될 수밖에 없는 셈이다. 앞서 코로나19 이후 한차례 호황기를 거쳤던 2021년과 2022년에도 반도체발 초과세수로 교육교부금이 갑자기 늘면서 ‘방만 집행’ 논란이 일었다.)

Fiscal authorities are pressuring education authorities by proposing specific reform plans. The Ministry of Economy and Finance is considering replacing the current uniform allocation based on total domestic tax revenue with a system linked to the nominal growth rate for increasing grants. Earlier, in a 2021 report, Kim Hak-soo, a senior research fellow at the Korea Development Institute (KDI), projected that under the current grant allocation system, per-capita nominal GDP would rise about 3.8 times from 2020 to 2060, while average education grants per school-age individual would increase nearly 5.5 times. Presenting these findings, Kim stated, "Given demographic changes and fiscal conditions, the current method of calculating education grants cannot be considered a rational allocation of resources. It becomes an obstacle to strategic investment." ( 재정당국은 구체적인 개편안을 제시하며 교육당국을 압박하고 있다. 기획예산처는 내국세 전체 세수를 기준으로 일률 배분하는 방식 대신, 경상성장률에 연동시켜 교부금을 늘려가는 방식 등을 검토하고 있다. 앞서 김학수 한국개발연구원(KDI) 선임연구위원은 2021년 보고서에서 지금과 같은 교부금 지급 방식을 유지할 경우, 인구 1명당 경상 국내총생산(GDP)은 2020년 대비 2060년에 약 3.8배 증가하는데, 초중등 학령인구 1인당 평균 교육교부금은 5.5배 가까이 증가할 것으로 전망한 바 있다. 김 연구위원은 이런 내용을 발표하며 “현재 교육교부금 산정 방식은 인구구조 변화와 재정 여건을 고려하면 합리적 재원 배분이라 볼 수 없다. 전략적 투자를 가로막는 요인이 된다”고 말했다.)

In contrast, the Ministry of Education is considering an alternative: maintaining the 20.79% linkage to domestic taxes but setting a cap on the funds used, while channeling surpluses into a provisional "Education Stabilization Fund" to be used when needed, instead of relying on supplementary budgets. There is also discussion about expanding the scope of education grants to cover early childhood and higher education. ( 반면 교육부는 내국세 20.79% 연동 구조는 그대로 유지하면서 일정 상한을 두고 재원으로 활용하되, 초과분을 가칭 ‘교육안정화기금’으로 조성하는 방안을 대안으로 검토 중이다. 세수가 많이 걷히는 해에 초과분을 적립해 필요한 때 추가경정예산 대신 해당 기금을 사용하겠다는 구상이다. 교육교부금의 사용처를 영유아·고등교육 등까지 넓히는 방안도 거론된다.)

However, the Ministry of Economy and Finance is steadily building public opinion in favor of reforming the grant allocation system. In a press briefing last April, Minister of Economy and Finance Park Hong-keun stated, "While the school-age population has significantly decreased, domestic taxes have increased, making local education finances far better off than local or central governments." At a "Fiscal Expenditure Restructuring Open Forum" on the 8th of this month, he further solidified the push for reform by saying, "The imbalance in education fiscal input must also be addressed." ( 그러나 기획예산처는 교육교부금 지급 방식 개편에 무게를 두고 차근차근 여론화 작업을 진행하고 있다. 박홍근 기획처 장관은 지난 4월 기자간담회에서 “학령인구는 많이 감소했는데 내국세는 늘면서 지방교육재정은 지방정부·중앙정부보다 형편이 매우 나은 편”이라고 말했다. 지난 8일 ‘지출 구조조정 열린 토론회’에서 “교육재정 투입의 불균형 또한 해소해야 한다”며 교부금 지급 방식 개편을 기정사실화하고 있다.)

Reporters Kim Yun-ju and Lee Woo-yeon kyj@hani.co.kr ( 김윤주 이우연 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)
